newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks mixed in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks mixed in early trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were narrowly mixed in early Monday trade, holding steady in cautious pre-holiday trade on good liquidity and despite the market's sharp rise and a large share placement on Friday, brokers said.
"I think we will move up since liquidity remains good and Wall Street has given little direction," said Chris Geiger in institutional sales at Vickers Ballas.
The Hang Seng Index edged up 1.85 points to 13,133.26 in early morning trade on bloated turnover of HK$3.31 billion.
"I don't see much downside besides what we saw in the last two weeks," Geiger added.

Turnover was inflated by a placement of 238 million shares of Sino Land at HK$9.13 each. The placement was expected to raise HK$2.17 billion. Sino Land shed HK$0.35 to HK$9.25 on trade of HK$2.19 billion.
On Wall Street on Friday, the Dow Industrials ended 10.76 points up at 6,484.40 in volatile trade, heavily influenced by options expiration.
The trend in the U.S. bond market was less positive with the long-bond dipping to yield 6.61 percent at end Friday, compared with 6.586 percent at end of trading in New York on Thursday.
The property sector outperformed the broad market in early trade, while utilities suffered another bout of profit taking. The Hang Seng China Enterprise Index dipped into negative territory.

Cheung Kong led the sector with a gain of HK$0.75 to HK$66.75 on low turnover of HK$44.62 million. Great Eagle was the next best performing property share, putting on HK$0.30 to HK$31.70. New World Development also added HK$0.30 to HK$49.00.
Hongkong Telecom shed HK$0.20 to HK$12.60 on low turnover of HK$33.0 million.
Technical analysts said the share is nearing its low for the year and could fall further in the coming month, weighing down the sector and the index.
Among the H shares, Guangshen Railway looked the best, adding HK$0.05 to HK$3.25 and Tsingtao Brewery rose to HK$0.025 to HK$2.825.
Kong Tai International was the second most actively traded stock, after Sino Land. The company placed 582 million new shares HK$0.25 a share. The stock rose HK$0.185 to HK$0.415.
